infotexts.entitydescription.Multi-toolSET: A composite tool; toggle welder/cutter, shine a built-in flashlight beam, enable extinguisher mode, and use a shared oxygen tank.
infotexts.entitydescription.wrenchscrewdrivertwoin: Designed for submarine engineers, double right-click to switch wrenches/screwdrivers.
infotexts.entitydescription.EmergencyServiceNodeSE: Throwable emergency node. It auto-sticks after impact, blinks green while armed, lights the room for 5 minutes, pumps and slowly repairs flooded compartments for up to 1 minute of charge, and releases up to 3 extinguisher bursts per full recharge. Recharge it in a battery charger or oxygen refiller.
